<!--
  A product as a card: picture, optional badge, category, name, rating, summary, price and an add button. Axes:
  layout (vertical, horizontal), media (image, none), ratio, rating (show, hide), action (button, none),
  density.
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { Product, ProductLabels } from "./product-card.types";

  export type ProductCardProps = {
    product: Product;
    labels: ProductLabels;
    badges: Record<string, string>;
    layout?: "vertical" | "horizontal";
    media?: "image" | "none";
    ratio?: "4/3" | "1/1" | "3/4";
    rating?: "show" | "hide";
    action?: "button" | "none";
    density?: "default" | "compact";
    onadd?: (id: string) => void;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Badge from "../primitives/badge/badge.svelte";
  import Box from "../primitives/box/box.svelte";
  import Button from "../primitives/button/button.svelte";
  import Card from "../primitives/card/card.svelte";
  import CardContent from "../primitives/card/card-content.svelte";
  import Group from "../primitives/group/group.svelte";
  import Text from "../primitives/text/text.svelte";
  import Title from "../primitives/title/title.svelte";
  import MediaFrame from "../components/media-frame.svelte";
  import Rating from "../components/rating.svelte";
  import { at, cn, fmtMoney, tpl } from "../utils";

  let {
    product,
    labels,
    badges,
    layout = "vertical",
    media = "image",
    ratio = "4/3",
    rating = "show",
    action = "button",
    density = "default",
    onadd,
  }: ProductCardProps = $props();
</script>

<Card
  variant="default"
  class={cn(
    "h-full gap-4 overflow-hidden",
    (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "flex flex-col sm:flex-row" : "flex flex-col")
  )}
  data-testid="item"
  data-layout={layout}
>
  {#if ((media as string) === "image")}
    <Box class={cn("relative shrink-0", (((layout as string) === "horizontal") ? "sm:w-48" : ""))}>
      <MediaFrame alt={product.name} ratio={ratio} class="h-full" />
      {#if product.badge}
        <Badge variant="default" size="default" class="absolute left-4 top-4" data-testid="badge">
          {at(badges, product.badge)}
        </Badge>
      {/if}
    </Box>
  {/if}
  <CardContent class="flex flex-1 flex-col gap-2">
    <Text size="xs" class="uppercase tracking-wide text-muted-foreground">
      {product.category}
    </Text>
    <Title as={3} size="base" weight="bold">
      {product.name}
    </Title>
    {#if ((rating as string) === "show")}
      <Group gap="2">
        <Rating value={product.rating} label={tpl(labels.ratingLabel, product.rating)} size={16} />
        <Text size="xs" class="text-muted-foreground">
          {tpl(labels.reviews, product.reviews)}
        </Text>
      </Group>
    {/if}
    {#if ((density as string) === "default")}
      <Text size="sm" class="text-muted-foreground">
        {product.summary}
      </Text>
    {/if}
    <Group gap="4" justify="between" class="mt-auto pt-2">
      <Text size="xl" weight="bold">
        {fmtMoney(product.price, product.currency)}
      </Text>
      {#if ((action as string) === "button")}
        <Button
          variant={(product.inStock ? "default" : "outline")}
          size="sm"
          disabled={!product.inStock}
          data-testid="add"
          onclick={() => onadd?.(product.id)}
        >
          {(product.inStock ? labels.add : labels.soldOut)}
        </Button>
      {/if}
    </Group>
  </CardContent>
</Card>
